columns.path: audio path used for detector evaluation
columns.reference_onset_sec: manual acoustic onset in seconds; initially blank

completed_reference_rule: a finite non-negative reference_onset_sec not marked excluded/invalid
manual_reference_policy: reference_onset_sec, annotator, annotation_status, and notes are blank on creation; the software never imputes a manual onset
prompt_eligibility_rule: rows with missing or blank prompt_text are excluded rather than assigned an invented prompt type

prompt_type_rules.isolated_token: after removing bracketed/parenthesized clarifiers, at most one alphanumeric spoken token remains
prompt_type_rules.sentence: after clarifier removal, at least two spoken tokens remain
prompt_type_rules.vocal_exercise: the entire normalized prompt is enclosed in square brackets

reference_time_unit: seconds from the beginning of the decoded/resampled file
shortage_rule: take all available rows in a deficient stratum and redistribute the deficit as evenly as possible among strata with remaining samples
